claim: One shared skill-quality labelling for every cross-domain memory method

label_semantics.why: The six source games are score-maximisation and survival games with no win condition, so 'did this episode succeed' has no answer and any absolute cut-off would be invented. What this study transfers is skill, not victory, and skill quality is exactly what separates a well-played episode from a badly played one within the same game. The three baselines consume a positive and a negative class; those classes are defined here as demonstration quality, and the artifacts record that so no reader mistakes them for task success.
label_semantics.reported_as: Papers must not describe these as success rates.

why_v1_was_withdrawn.finding: v1 declared ABSTAIN for all six games and delegated to an LLM judge asking whether the game's objective was achieved.
evidence: The judge's verdict was predicted by the terminated flag alone in 33/36 episodes (92%).
It returned 14 SUCCESS, 0 FAILURE, 22 UNKNOWN, leaving ExpeL with no contrast and ReasoningBank with no pitfalls.
It was anti-correlated with actual play quality: tetris episodes that terminated had median score 128 versus 220 for those that survived, and every terminated episode was labelled SUCCESS.
On gymv_columns it labelled an episode whose observation reads 'Gameover: 3' with a near-minimum score of 60 as 'successfully achieved the game's objective before game over'.
why_v1_was_withdrawn.conclusion: Asking for victory in a game that has none forces the judge onto a structural proxy. The question was wrong, not the judge.

cohort_rule.why_this_is_not_reward_greater_than_zero: The comparison is relative and within-game: an episode is ranked only against other episodes of the same game produced by the same policy. No fixed number is applied, and no threshold crosses domains.
cohort_rule.abstention: The middle tercile is withheld. A game whose cohort is below minimum_cohort, or whose scores tie so heavily that the two quantiles collapse onto one value, abstains entirely rather than forcing a tie-break.

observed_on_pilot_n6.decorrelation_check: terminated=True gives 2 high / 6 low and terminated=False gives 10 high / 4 low, so the label is no longer a proxy for the termination flag and now runs in the correct direction.

shared_evaluator.why: The cohort rule resolves what the game's own metric can resolve and abstains otherwise. Re-adding an LLM judge on top would only relabel the abstention band, which is precisely the band the game provides no evidence about, and v1 showed that a judge asked to fill that band answers from structural artefacts instead.
shared_evaluator.may_be_reinstated_if: A judge is shown to decorrelate from terminated/truncated on a held-out cohort and to agree with the within-game ranking where the two overlap.

preregistered_empty_bank_rule.trigger: A method resolves to fewer than 1 eligible source episode
preregistered_empty_bank_rule.action: induce_memory_artifact raises InsufficientEligibleSourceError and the arm is reported as empty rather than rescued by widening the quantiles
